_about: ETH GET_PUBLIC_KEY (CLA 0xE0 INS 0x02) chain-code layout. These vectors require the real Rust FFI (the BIP-32 chain code and the keccak address cannot be reproduced by FakeCryptoService), so `needsCrypto: true` — they run in a future integration_test runner and are reported as deferred by the structural runner. Provenance `regression`: bytes snapshotted from the Rust implementation for a fixed 64-byte seed (not yet a speculos capture). Expected layout per app-ethereum/doc/apdu.md:59-81 and get_public_key.c:46-58: [0x41][65B pubkey][0x28][40B ASCII addr] (+ [32B chain code] when P2=0x01)[SW].

vectors.note: P2=0x00 → address only, no chain code. Path defaults to m/44'/60'/0'/0/0 (no data).
P2=0x01 → the same address plus the trailing 32-byte BIP-32 chain code (6ffbe8f2…c6b823), so the host can rebuild an xpub.
